Subject: Migration PoC: architecture review for CoreAI

Hi Marissa / Vivek,

Thanks again for yesterday's product overview — that was helpful. We're planning a Migration PoC to move from our current self-hosted Triton setup (and a few ad-hoc model endpoints) to an inference provider for lower operational overhead. Before committing, we'd like a technical deep-dive/architecture review to make sure the PoC covers the right integration points (prefix caching, KV cache behavior, quantization impact, and network egress requirements).

Can we schedule a 60-90 minute architecture session next week? Attendees from our side: myself (platform lead), Priya Sharma (infra), and Daniel Lee (ML infra). We'd like to cover:
- Current deployment snapshot (attachment)
- Expected latency and throughput targets
- Data flow and security boundaries
- Rollback & canary plan for the PoC

Attachment: current-deployment-diagram.png (1 file)

Preferred windows for us: Tue/Wed afternoons (PT) or Thu morning PT. If you can propose 2 options I can confirm.

Thanks,
Alex
